'''The Mill''' was a building that was located in the settlement [[Dalia (township)|Dalia]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]].

==Description==
The Mill was the only lumber cutting facility on [[Dalicron-4]] and was constructed decades before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was used only when a building project on the planet required cut lumber and the people of Dalia kept it well maintained, so that they could rebuild the town when the planet's frequent storms damaged buildings.
